QUOTE: "**Compile time.** Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... **Run time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` without the two macros, then call once at startup: `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free);`" and "`platform.c:20` omits all runtime machinery."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. It also shows they are exclusive: the runtime route requires the macros to be undefined, and defining them omits the runtime machinery.
